name: @rune-langium/worker-core
description: Shared cross-cutting utilities for rune-langium's plain Cloudflare Workers (lsp-worker, codegen-worker, telemetry-worker, curated-mirror-worker). Ships structured logging (./log) — a pino/browser logger with this fleet's shared redact-path baseline, real redaction, and console.log(obj) convention baked in — and origin-allowlist matching with CF Pages preview wildcard support (./origin), with room to grow other shared Worker concerns as sibling modules.
author: Pradeep Mouli <pmouli@mac.com> (https://github.com/pradeepmouli)
